author: Mario Munoz
text: We got referred to Tim as we were having septic problems today. Tim happened to be at the gas station down the road from our house when we called and stopped by on his way home, and took care of the issue!  Very informative, professional and all around amazing! We need more Tim’s in this world! 10 stars for yavapai septic!

author: Janie Z
text: Tim with Yavapai Septic is one of the most dedicated and hard working people out there. He's always reliable and willing to help...even in the snow!

author: JT
text: Tim has been our go to septic guy since we bought our house in Sedona. Excellent service at fair prices.

author: Jessica Cheatham
text: Tim and his son were absolutely amazing. I called and they got me in the next day! Very nice and professional guys. I was very impressed by their work. After digging up the tank they left my yard looking as if nothing was ever disturbed. The line of communication was amazing, they were prompt and on time. 10 out of 10 would recommend!

author: Bad Lobo
text: Septic got backed up and needed same day service. Tim answered the phone and told him about my problem and he came the same day and cleared out my Septic tank. Tim is very professional, and I would recommend digging up your Septic tank cover before you call. The service cost was very reasonable. Would recommend Yavapai septic service for your septic needs.
